notes: Napoleon Orda’s 1875 watercolor of the Jesuit church on the Daugava (#8) is a good alternate for P4 but only 37 years from 1912, so not added as a second P4 view. The 2016 panorama shows mostly Soviet-era housing rather than the old center; no better modern view was offered.
